updated_scope: Use original V07 library music duration. No extension, looping, new composition or 128-BPM retiming.
method_notes: Decoded float32 native 44100Hz stereo; >0dBFS AAC decoded values are preserved for measurement.
Onset candidates are positive log-STFT changes refined by waveform RMS-rise; not downbeats or heard musical beats.
Structural changes are broad band-energy statistics, not heard verse/drop labels.
Nearest 25fps frame creates <=20ms event quantization; timestamps retain native-audio samples.
